entries.content: instruction; (i-5) 'Wisdom' here and in ver. 7 is chokmah. 'Instruction' means also, 'correction,' 'warning,' 'discipline,' Job 36.10.
wisdom, (k-6) Sachal, it means 'intelligence,' 'circumspection,' and 'understanding,' as in ch. 3.4, also 'success,' 'good esteem.' see 'succeeded better,' 1Sam. 18.30.
simple, (l-6) 'Simple,' in this book, means one lacking in the powers of the soul and mind, and hence easily enticed and misled. discretion. (m-13) Or 'reflection,' 'sagacity.'

fools (o-10) Eveel. It is the generic word, but has two shades of meaning according as it is opposed to chakam, 'wise,' or aroom, 'prudent,' 'wary,' ch. 12.16. But the idea of 'wickedness' is not absent from it. As to details, kesil is usually rendered 'foolish,' as ver. 22; ch. 12.23, nabal is rather 'vile,' 'impious.' see 1Sam. 25.3,25. wisdom (p-12) See ver. 2.
Wisdom (b-1) A feminine plural form as Ps. 49.3. so chs. 9.1; 14.1; 24.7, &c.
wisdom (f-5) Or 'true wisdom,' or 'soundness;' and so chs. 3.21; 8.14. see Job 6.13; 12.16.

judgment (h-7) 'Just judgment' or 'justice.' path. (i-12) The word is difficult to render. It is properly 'a path going round,' and hence used for the 'entrenchment' of a war camp, as 'wagon-defence' in 1Sam. 17.20. It is applied, as in Ps. 17.5; 23.3, to God's path for the saint, which does not always lead where we expect, or so that we can see straight on in it; and also to the shifting ways of the wicked, as ver. 18; and so in ver. 15, where the plural is rendered collectively 'course.'
things; (a-15) Or 'deceits,' plural, as often. see Ps. 5.9; 11.7.
frowardness (a-10) Or 'deceits,' plural, as often. see Ps. 5.9; 11.7.
perverted (c-8) See Note, ch. 3.32. course. (d-11) See Note i, ver. 9.
paths (d-10) See Note i, ver. 9. dead; (f-13) Or 'shades,' as Job. 26.5, see Ps. 88.10.
land, (g-10) Or 'earth.' unfaithful (h-13) More exactly, 'faithless,' 'perfidious,' 'treacherous,' but used as towards God. see Ps. 78.57; Jer. 3.20.
understanding (i-8) Or 'sense,' 'wisdom,' or 'esteem.' see Note, ch. 1.3.
plain (l-11) Or 'straight;' and so ch. 11.5. see Ps. 5.8.
instruction (m-6) See ch. 1.2. chastisement; (n-14) Or 'loathe not his reproof.'
up, (a-8) Or 'were torn up.' see Gen. 7.11; or 'burst forth.'
keep (b-10) Strictly, 'observe;' and so ch. 4.13; Job 7.20. wisdom (c-12) Or 'true counsel.' see Note, ch. 2.7.
perverse (d-3) Strictly, 'turned aside,' 'perverted,' as chs. 2.15; 14.2. It is the opposite of jashar, 'upright,' in this verse.
wisdom; (g-7) Or, 'Wisdom is the principal thing. get wisdom.' 'Beginning' is as Gen. 1.1; Ps. 111.10; Prov. 1.7. see Note b, Lev. 2.12.
corrupt (c-9) Lit. 'corruptness of,' 'inconsistency,' or 'perverseness of.' same root word as ch. 3.32.
path (d-3) See Note i, ch. 2.9. well-ordered. (e-13) Or 'and all thy ways shall be established.'
reflection, (f-5) Or 'well-considered thoughts,' it is plural. for singular see ch. 1.4, 'discretion.'
ways (h-10) Or 'paths.' see Note i, ch. 2.9. [whither]. (i-15) Or 'Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life, her ways are changeable. thou canst not know [them].'
fountains (l-2) Ver. 16 as ch. 8.24; ver. 18 as ch. 10.11.
fountain (l-3) Ver. 16 as ch. 8.24; ver. 18 as ch. 10.11.
man (a-5) Ish. paths. (b-17) Or 'path.' see Note i, ch. 2.9.

discipline; (c-7) Or 'instruction.' astray. (d-18) 'Shall go astray' is the same root word as 'be ravished' in vers. 19,20. But the passage is surely made plain by chap. 26.11. 'he shall go on in a multiplied course of folly.'

thyself, (f-21) Or 'submit thyself,' as Ps. 68.30. with (g-25) A rare strong word implying fierceness -- to be moved violently. Translated 'encourage,' Ps. 138.3; 'overcome,' Cant. 6.5; 'insolent,' Isa. 3.5. The insistence would be to get him to discharge the debt at once.
perverse (i-15) Or 'perverted.' Lit. 'perverseness of,' as ch. 4.24.
soweth (k-13) Lit. 'sendeth out' -- intensive -- so ver. 19, ch. 16.28.
uttereth (m-5) Lit. 'that breatheth out.' see Ps. 27.12.
understanding. (a-10) Or 'senseless.' strictly, 'lacking heart,' and so often.
for (f-17) Or 'as one in fetters [goeth] to.'
plain (c-4) See 'right on,' ch. 4.25. right (d-10) Or 'straight,' as ch. 4. 25.
reflection. (f-13) Here the plural, as ch. 5.2.
mouth (g-19) Or 'mouth of deceits.' see ch. 2.12,14.
rulers (h-6) Or 'ministers [of state],' as Judg. 5.3; Ps. 2.2.
strong; (p-14) Or 'when [he] strengthened the fountains of the deep.'
nursling, (q-7) The nursling of his love. Or '[his] artificer.' The Hebrew is linked with 'artist' in Cant. 7.1. rejoicing (r-14) Or 'disporting.'
rejoicing (r-1) Or 'disporting.' part (s-5) Lit. 'world,' Tebel, as 'circuit,' Job 37.12. That part of the earth fitted for man to live on. see 1Sam. 2.8; Ps. 90.2; 96.10.
cattle, (d-5) Lit. 'her slaughtering.' see Gen. 43.16. prepared (e-14) Or 'furnished,' as Ps. 78.19.
follies (g-2) Strictly, 'simplicities.' plural of 'simple,' vers. 4,16; ch. 1.4.
of (h-8) Or 'the principle of.' Not as ch. 1.7. Holy (i-15) Or 'of holy things;' plural, as ch. 30.3.
violence. (m-17) Or 'but violence covereth the mouth of the wicked.'
fool. (i-17) Kesil. see Note o, ch. 1.7.
it. (k-14) Or 'toil addeth nothing to it.'
unfaithful (b-13) Or 'treacherous,' as ver. 6. see ch. 2.22.
hypocrite (c-5) Or 'an impious man.' neighbour; (d-8) Or 'friend,' as often. so ver. 12.
another; (g-10) Or 'a stranger.' see Note, chs. 5.10; 27.2. suretyship (h-15) Lit. 'those that strike [hands].'
soul; (k-9) Or 'The kind man doeth good to himself.'
work; (l-6) Or 'a work that deceiveth him.'
souls. (a-15) Or 'he that winneth souls is wise.' All the adjectives in vers. 29-31 are in the singular. In general this is denoted by the addition of '[man].'
wisdom; (c-8) Sachal. see Note k, ch. 1.3.
[heareth] (a-4) Some read '... son [is the fruit of] his. ...'
violence. (b-18) Or 'the desire of the faithless is violence.'
it; (d-9) i.e. held accountable. Others render 'destroyeth himself.'
understanding (e-2) Or 'Good sense.' Sachal, as ch. 1.3. hard. (f-12) Or 'rugged.'
poor; (a-9) Or 'indigent,' as ver. 8. judgment. (b-19) Or 'that is destroyed through injustice.'
betimes. (c-16) Lit. 'seeketh him earnestly (or 'early') with discipline.'
uttereth (e-11) As ch. 6.19; so ver. 25; ch. 19.5,9.
evil-doing; (c-8) Or 'in his calamity.' trusteth, (d-12) Or 'is full of confidence.'
reproach (e-9) Or 'disgrace.' peoples. (f-11) Leummim. see Ps. 2.1.
Gentleness (g-1) Or 'Benignity;' as 'sound,' ch. 14.30. breaking (h-14) Or 'disturbance.'
plain. (a-20) Or 'raised up as a causeway.' see ch. 16.17. As 'cast up.' Isa. 57.14.
sense; (b-10) Strictly, 'heart.' see chs. 6.32; 11.12. walk. (c-18) Or 'walketh straight forwards,' or 'uprightly.'
discipline (e-7) Or 'instruction,' as ver. 32. see Note, ch. 1.2.
Commit (g-1) Lit. 'Roll.' see Ps. 37.5. established. (h-11) Or 'accomplished.'
heed (b-4) Or 'acts wisely,' from Sachal, ch. 1.3. see Note, Ps. 41.1.
intelligent, (b-9) Or 'acts wisely,' from Sachal, ch. 1.3. see Note, Ps. 41.1.
false (e-2) Or 'froward,' as ch. 2.12. soweth (f-4) Or 'sendeth out.' talebearer (g-8) Or 'slanderer.'
feasting (h-14) Lit. 'sacrifices,' Zevach. see Note, Deut. 12.21.
speech (k-2) Lit. 'lip.' [man]; (l-7) Or 'a fool,' Nabal. see ch 1.7. As Ps. 14.1, and ch. 30.22.
fool. (b-17) Kesil. so vers. 12,16,21,24. (In ver. 28 it is Eveel. as ch. 1.7.) Also chs. 18.2,6,7; 19.1,10.
rebellion; (c-6) Or 'A rebel seeketh only evil.'
wicked, (d-5) righteous, (d-11) The words are in the singular and characteristic; and so in ch. 18.5.
sense? (e-21) Strictly, 'void of heart,' as ch. 15.21. see ch. 6.32, &c.
senseless (e-2) Strictly, 'void of heart,' as ch. 15.21. see ch. 6.32, &c. neighbour. (f-10) Or 'friend,' as ver. 17 and ch. 6.1, &c.
before (h-3) Or 'on the face of.' see Eccles. 8.1.
belly. (a-20) Or 'into the depths (lit. 'chambers') of the soul;' and so chs. 20.27,30; 26.22.
safe. (b-16) Or 'unapproachable;' lit. 'set in a high retreat.' see Ps. 20.1.
friends (e-5) Or 'companions,' 'associates,' Ps. 38.11. friend (f-14) Lit. 'lover,' as Ps. 38.11. see ch. 14.20.
lion; (c-10) Strictly, 'young lion,' as Job 4.10, &c.; and so chs. 20.2; 28.1.
him. (e-15) Others, 'and regard not his crying.'
beware; (i-8) Or 'will become prudent,' as ch. 15.5; 1Sam. 23.22.
children (a-10) Or 'The righteous who walketh ... blessed shall be ...'
measures, (b-4) Lit. 'A stone and a stone, an ephah and an ephah.'
strangers. (d-16) Some read 'the strange woman,' conforming this passage to ch. 27.13.
blackest (e-16) Lit. 'the eyeball of.' see ch. 7.9.
hallowed, (i-13) Or 'to appropriate to himself a holy thing.'
Mercy (l-1) mercy. (l-13) Or 'kindness,' 'bounty;' chesed, and so ch. 21.21.
wisdom (c-10) Sachal. see ch. 1.3. dead. (d-18) Or 'shades;' cf. ch. 2.18.
constantly. (e-13) Or 'always' or 'unchallenged,' as 'in victory,' Isa. 25.8.
unfaithful. (e-14) Or 'treacherous [man].' as ch. 21.18. see chs. 2.22 and 25.19.
poor, (f-5) As ch. 10.15. want. (g-20) Or 'He that oppresseth the poor to make increase for himself [and] he that giveth to the rich shall certainly [come] to want.'
instruction, (b-5) Or 'correction.' see ver. 13 and ch. 1.2.
fear (c-12) Or 'but [let it covet] the fear.'
result, (d-6) Or 'end;' 'future,' as ch. 24.14,20. Ps. 37.37. see Note k, ver. 32.
sorrow? (g-6) Lit. 'Whose is, ''Oh!'' Whose is, ''woe is me!''?' redness (h-16) Or 'darkening.'
last (k-3) Or 'in result;' lit. 'in its end.' as ver. 18.
advice (b-4) Or 'wise counsels,' as chs. 1.5; 11.14; 20.18. safety. (c-18) Or 'victory,' as ch. 11.14.
fool. (d-7) Or 'Jewels (lit. 'high-priced things') for a fool are wisdom.'
small. (e-13) There is a play on the words 'trouble' and 'small.'
tongue. (a-13) Or 'So doth a backbiting (lit. 'secret') tongue, an angry countenance.'
weight. (c-18) Or 'is glory,' the word having both meanings. Or 'so [for men] to seek their own glory is [not] glory.'
fool. (d-15) Kesil. so in all this passage, vers. 1 to 12. see ch. 1.7.
stoneheap, (f-8) Or 'As the binding of a stone in a sling.'
passers-by. (g-14) Or 'as an archer that woundeth all, so is he that hireth,' &c.
friend; (b-7) As ch. 18.24. strictly, 'one who loves.'
thy (e-13) Lit. 'set thine heart on the.'
man (a-3) Geber. so ver 21. see Job 3.3. 'Poor,' in vers. 3,6,27, as ch. 22.2. helpless (b-7) Dal, 'poor,' plural, as chs. 10.15; 22.16; 29.7,14.
wealth, (e-9) Or 'he that hasteth after wealth hath an evil eye.'
fool; (a-10) Kesil. see note o, ch. 1.7.
reproved (b-5) Lit. ver. 1 'A man of reproofs;' ver. 4. 'a man of gifts.'
gifts (b-13) Lit. ver. 1 'A man of reproofs;' ver. 4. 'a man of gifts.'
man (c-2) Geber. so ch. 30.1,19. see Job 3.3.
fool, (e-8) Lit. 'a man, a fool' (Ish eveel). see ch. 1.7.
soul. (f-12) Others, 'and [as for] the upright, they seek his life.'
fool (a-2) Kesil. see note o, ch. 1.7. mind; (g-6) Or 'passion.' keepeth (h-11) Lit. 'keepeth back and calmeth.'
son. (l-19) Strictly, 'son of the house;' i.e. he gets into possession of his master's goods.
protected. (b-16) Or 'shall be set on high.' see Ps. 20.1; 69.29.
prophecy (c-10) Lit. 'burden' or 'oracle;' as 'music,' 1Chron. 15.22. The word 'uttered,' here is as Ps. 36.1.
word (e-2) Imrah. see Ps. 119.11. pure. (f-6) Or 'tried,' as Ps. 18.30. see Ps. 119.140.
outrage (g-21) Strictly, 'lay hands on.' for this use of the word, see ver. 28.
churl (a-9) Or 'fool,' 'vile person,' Nabal. see ch. 1.7.
lion, (c-2) Strictly, 'an old lion.' see Job 4.11.
rulers (f-17) As ch. 8.15. drink? (g-24) Some read 'to desire strong drink.'
desolate. (h-16) Lit. 'sons of decease' (i.e. of those deceased).
(i-0) From ver. 10 to the end, the initial Hebrew letter of each verse follows the alphabetical order. rubies. (k-14) As ch. 3.15.
hands. (l-11) Lit. 'palms' here and in Num. 5.18.
work (m-18) Or 'daily provision.' see Note d, Ex. 12.24.
hands (l-13) Lit. 'palms' here and in Num. 5.18.
hands (a-4) Not the same word as that marked b in vers. 19 and 20. hands (b-10) Lit. 'palms.' see Note l, v. 13.
hands (a-14) Not the same word as that marked b in vers. 19 and 20. hand (b-5) Lit. 'palms.' see Note l, v. 13.
hands, (a-8) Not the same word as that marked b in vers. 19 and 20.
